title: Soulhoard
description: A plugin that lets you steal the souls of your enemies! Kill players to steal their souls and ban them. Being killed by someone releases all of your victims and gets you banned in the process.
body: Killing a player gives you their soul (which means they are banned from the server). You can choose to release the soul (unban the player). They can also get their soul back if someone else kills you. /soulhoard to acces the subcommands (/soulhoard help to get descriptions of the subcommands). The commands allow you to release souls, view whose souls you have or lend someone else your souls. There are also admin commands that let you access some settings or manage players' kill lists.
